reference_sql:
SELECT brand,
       CASE
         WHEN unit_cost_eur IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
         WHEN unit_cost_eur < 30 THEN 'budget'
         WHEN unit_cost_eur < 150 THEN 'core'
         ELSE 'flagship'
       END AS cost_tier,
       COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
GROUP BY brand,
         CASE
           WHEN unit_cost_eur IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
           WHEN unit_cost_eur < 30 THEN 'budget'
           WHEN unit_cost_eur < 150 THEN 'core'
           ELSE 'flagship'
         END
ORDER BY brand, cost_tier

SELECT brand,
       CASE
         WHEN unit_cost_eur < 30 THEN 'budget'
         WHEN unit_cost_eur >= 30 AND unit_cost_eur < 150 THEN 'core'
         WHEN unit_cost_eur >= 150 THEN 'flagship'
         ELSE 'unknown'
       END AS cost_tier,
       COUNT(product_id) AS n_products
FROM products
WHERE category_id >= 15 AND category_id <= 20
GROUP BY brand,
         CASE
           WHEN unit_cost_eur < 30 THEN 'budget'
           WHEN unit_cost_eur >= 30 AND unit_cost_eur < 150 THEN 'core'
           WHEN unit_cost_eur >= 150 THEN 'flagship'
           ELSE 'unknown'
         END
ORDER BY brand ASC, cost_tier ASC

solver.query:
SELECT p.brand,
       CASE WHEN p.unit_cost_eur IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
            WHEN p.unit_cost_eur < 30.00 THEN 'budget'
            WHEN p.unit_cost_eur < 150.00 THEN 'core'
            ELSE 'flagship' END AS cost_tier,
       COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 20
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY brand ASC, cost_tier ASC
